blocks.text: Jo khasiyatein sex chromosomes par maujood alleles se control hoti hain unhein sex-linked traits (khasiyatein) kehte hain, aur is amal ko sex linkage kehte hain. Sex-linked khasiyat asal mein X-linked hoti hai, kyunke Y chromosome par aam taur par taqreeban koi kaam ka (functional) gene nahi hota. Isi liye sex-linked khasiyaton ki ratio nar aur maada mein mukhtalif hoti hai. Lekin bohat kam khasiyaton ke alleles X aur Y dono par hote hain. Aisi khasiyatein nar aur maada mein barabar hoti hain aur X-Y-linked ya pseudo-autosomal khasiyatein kehlati hain.

blocks.prompt: Pseudo-autosomal khasiyatein nar aur maada mein barabar kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Un ke alleles X aur Y dono par hain, is liye nar aur maada dono ke paas do copies hoti hain, bilkul autosome ke genes ki tarah.

items: Sex-linked ka matlab aam taur par X-linked, kyunke Y par taqreeban koi functional gene nahi.
X aur Y dono par alleles: X-Y-linked (pseudo-autosomal) khasiyatein, dono jinson mein barabar.
